effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 7 enemies in a 4m radius around the closest enemy, dealing 34 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 4s. bio: All Cambion battle the Demon blood in their veins, but Jyuka nearly lost. He began to transform, and he feared the worst – until he met Jutsubo, and she helped bind his inner monster to his weapon, halting his corruption. The two Cambion have been faithful friends ever since.
